```{r}
#| include: false
here::i_am("dashboard/index.qmd")
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(plotly)
library(mapgl)
library(DT)

pub_dir <- here::here("data", "published")
if (!dir.exists(pub_dir)) stop("data/published not found at ", pub_dir, "; check the here() root")
pub <- function(f) file.path(pub_dir, f)
read_pub <- function(f, ...) if (file.exists(pub(f))) read_csv(pub(f), show_col_types = FALSE, ...) else NULL
missing_note <- function(f) htmltools::p(sprintf("Not yet published: data/published/%s", f))
fmt_share <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x)

headline <- read_pub("headline.csv")
track    <- read_pub("kalman_track.csv")
ledger   <- read_pub("poll_ledger.csv")
gates    <- read_pub("gates.csv")

comp <- function(name) if (is.null(headline)) NULL else filter(headline, component == name)
combined     <- comp("combined")
fundamentals <- comp("fundamentals")

ungated <- if (is.null(gates)) NULL else filter(gates, status == "UNGATED")
ungated_for <- function(qs) {
  if (is.null(ungated)) return(NULL)
  hits <- filter(ungated, affects %in% qs)
  if (!nrow(hits)) NULL else sprintf("UNGATED: %s", paste(hits$gate, collapse = ", "))
}
```

  color = "light"
)

## Gate notes {height="6%"}

```{r}
notes <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(c("combined", "poll", "fundamentals"), function(q) {
  n <- ungated_for(q)
  if (is.null(n)) NULL else sprintf("%s estimate: %s", q, sub("^UNGATED: ", "", n))
}))
if (is.null(gates)) missing_note("gates.csv") else if (!length(notes))
  htmltools::p("All gates affecting the headline components passed.") else
  htmltools::p(htmltools::strong("UNGATED "), paste(notes, collapse = "; "))
```

## Map {height="60%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Precinct (VTD) projections, Talarico two-party share"
site_url <- sub("/$", "", Sys.getenv("SITE_URL"))
map_gate <- ungated_for(c("regional", "vtd_model"))
if (!file.exists(pub("regions.geojson"))) missing_note("regions.geojson") else
if (!nzchar(site_url)) htmltools::p("Map tiles are built only in the deploy workflow (SITE_URL unset).") else {
  breaks <- c(0.2, 0.35, 0.5, 0.65, 0.8)
  cols <- c("#b2182b", "#ef8a62", "#f7f7f7", "#67a9cf", "#2166ac")
  pct <- function(col) number_format(get_column(col), style = "percent", maximum_fraction_digits = 1)
  m <- maplibre(style = carto_style("positron"), bounds = c(-106.65, 25.84, -93.51, 36.5)) |>
    add_pmtiles_source(id = "regions", url = paste0(site_url, "/regions.pmtiles"),
                       promote_id = "region_id") |>
    add_fill_layer(
      id = "regions-fill", source = "regions", source_layer = "regions",
      fill_color = interpolate(column = "mean", values = breaks, stops = cols),
      fill_opacity = 0.8, fill_outline_color = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      tooltip = concat(
        "<strong>", get_column("region_label"), "</strong>",
        "<br>Talarico two-party share: ", pct("mean"),
        "<br>90% interval: ", pct("q05"), " to ", pct("q95"),
        "<br>P(Talarico two-party share > 50%): ", pct("p_talarico")
      ),
      hover_options = list(fill_opacity = 1)
    ) |>
    add_legend("Talarico two-party share", values = sprintf("%d%%", 100 * breaks),
               colors = cols, type = "continuous")
  if (is.null(map_gate)) m else htmltools::tagList(htmltools::p(htmltools::strong(map_gate)), m)
}
```

## Track {height="28%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Daily Kalman poll track and polls used, Talarico two-party share (expand for full view)"
if (is.null(track)) missing_note("kalman_track.csv") else {
  track <- track |>
    select(-any_of("win_prob")) |>
    arrange(date) |>
    mutate(lo = mean - 1.96 * se, hi = mean + 1.96 * se)
  obs <- filter(track, !projected)
  proj <- filter(track, projected | date == max(obs$date))
  blue <- "31,119,180"
  p <- plot_ly(x = ~date) |>
    add_ribbons(data = obs, ymin = ~lo, ymax = ~hi, name = "Observed 95% band",
                fillcolor = sprintf("rgba(%s,0.25)", blue), line = list(width = 0),
                hoverinfo = "skip") |>
    add_ribbons(data = proj, ymin = ~lo, ymax = ~hi, name = "Projected 95% band",
                fillcolor = sprintf("rgba(%s,0.10)", blue), line = list(width = 0),
                hoverinfo = "skip") |>
    add_lines(data = obs, y = ~mean, name = "Observed mean",
              line = list(color = sprintf("rgb(%s)", blue))) |>
    add_lines(data = proj, y = ~mean, name = "Projected mean (after last poll)",
              line = list(color = sprintf("rgb(%s)", blue), dash = "dash"))
  if (!is.null(fundamentals) && nrow(fundamentals)) {
    fb <- tibble(date = range(track$date),
                 lo = fundamentals$mean - 1.96 * fundamentals$sd,
                 hi = fundamentals$mean + 1.96 * fundamentals$sd)
    p <- p |> add_ribbons(data = fb, ymin = ~lo, ymax = ~hi,
                          name = "Fundamentals prior 95% band", hoverinfo = "skip",
                          fillcolor = "rgba(127,127,127,0.2)", line = list(width = 0))
  }
  if (!is.null(ledger)) {
    polls <- ledger |>
      mutate(hover = sprintf(
        "<b>%s</b><br>Field end: %s<br>n = %s<br>Talarico %s, Paxton %s, other %s%s<br>Talarico two-party share: %s<br>Relative weight: %s<br>Source: %s",
        pollster, end_date, n, talarico, paxton, other,
        ifelse(brown_named, " (Brown named)", ""), fmt_share(talarico_2p),
        fmt_share(weight), source))
    p <- p |> plotly::add_markers(data = polls, x = ~end_date, y = ~talarico_2p, name = "Polls used",
                          text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text",
                          marker = list(color = "rgba(40,40,40,0.7)",
                                        size = ~pmax(5, 40 * sqrt(weight))))
  }
  p |> layout(
    yaxis = list(title = "Talarico two-party share", tickformat = ".0%"),
    xaxis = list(title = "", rangeslider = list(visible = TRUE)),
    legend = list(orientation = "h"),
    shapes = list(list(type = "line", xref = "paper", x0 = 0, x1 = 1, y0 = 0.5, y1 = 0.5,
                       line = list(dash = "dot", color = "grey")))
  )
}
```

## Bottom {height="12%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Poll ledger"
if (is.null(ledger)) missing_note("poll_ledger.csv") else {
  ledger_names <- c(pollster = "Pollster", end_date = "End date", n = "n",
                    talarico = "Talarico", paxton = "Paxton", other = "Other",
                    brown_named = "Brown named", talarico_2p = "Talarico two-party share",
                    weight = "Relative weight", source = "Source")
  shown <- intersect(names(ledger_names), names(ledger))
  ledger <- ledger[, c(shown, setdiff(names(ledger), shown))]
  pct_cols <- which(names(ledger) %in% c("talarico_2p", "weight"))
  htmltools::tags$details(
    htmltools::tags$summary(sprintf("Show all %d polls used by the model", nrow(ledger))),
    datatable(ledger, rownames = FALSE,
              colnames = unname(c(ledger_names[shown], setdiff(names(ledger), shown))),
              options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)) |>
      formatPercentage(pct_cols, digits = 1)
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| title: "Methodology notes: model gates"
if (is.null(gates)) missing_note("gates.csv") else {
  items <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(gates)), function(i) {
    g <- gates[i, ]
    status <- if (g$status == "UNGATED") htmltools::strong("UNGATED") else g$status
    htmltools::tags$li(htmltools::tags$code(g$gate), " (", g$affects, "): ", status,
                       if (!is.na(g$detail)) paste0(". ", g$detail))
  })
  htmltools::tags$details(
    htmltools::tags$summary(sprintf("%d gates, %d UNGATED", nrow(gates), sum(gates$status == "UNGATED"))),
    htmltools::tags$ul(items)
  )
}
```
